comparison.objective: Load and center a wafer on a spin-coater chuck using dedicated tools.
comparison.physical_skill: Edge-only tweezer handling, aligner docking, and lid counterholding.
comparison.success_condition: Wafer centered within 0.5 mm, aligner removed, lid closed, and forbidden contact avoided.
comparison.reason: Tool-mediated precision placement is different from screw–locknut calibration.
